description: Generates a security.txt file (RFC 9116): the standard file at /.well-known/security.txt on a website that tells security researchers where to report the vulnerabilities (security bugs) they find. Takes contact URIs (mailto:, https:, tel:), an optional expiry date and optional fields (PGP encryption key, disclosure policy, acknowledgments, languages, canonical URL, hiring). Returns the file text, or a message per invalid field. Does not write a full vulnerability disclosure policy or check a live website.

acknowledgments.description: https URL of your security acknowledgments page.

canonical.description: https URL where this file will be published, e.g. https://example.com/.well-known/security.txt.

contact.description: Security contact where researchers send vulnerability reports: mailto: e-mail address, https: web form or tel: phone URIs, most preferred first.

encryption.description: https URL of your OpenPGP (PGP) public key for encrypted reports.

expires.description: Expiry date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Default: about one year from today, as RFC 9116 recommends.

hiring.description: https URL of security job openings.

policy.description: https URL of your vulnerability disclosure policy (VDP or coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy).

name: security_txt_generate
title: Generate a security.txt file
